description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
summary: Superpowers is a composable skills layer that forces your coding agent through spec, design sign-off, and a TDD-driven plan before it writes code, which is the structural discipline I want when I'm routing parallel sessions through PenguPool or driving them from AgentOn Pocket on my phone. I appreciate that it's expressed as auto-triggering skills rather than a monolithic system prompt, so it drops into whatever harness I already use without re-architecting my setup. The subagent review loop—each task inspected before the next starts—is the closest thing I've seen to making long autonomous runs observable and trustworthy instead of a firehose I have to babysit.
